# Padua Thesis and Dissertations Archive

> Open-access institutional repository of the University of Padua preserving and disseminating student theses and dissertations across multiple disciplines.

The Padua Thesis and Dissertations Archive (Padua@thesis) is the official open-access repository managed by Università di Padova for the preservation and public dissemination of graduate and doctoral theses. The archive operates under Creative Commons CC0 licensing and follows the University's Open Access Regulations, making research outputs freely accessible to the global academic community.

## Featured Research

- [Simulazione del Travaglio: Una nuova strategia per potenziare la consapevolezza genitoriale, la competenza e promuovere un'esperienza di parto positiva: uno studio RCT.](https://thesis.unipd.it/handle/20.500.12608/104509): Labor simulation RCT thesis on parental awareness and childbirth experience
- [Il bilanciamento tra diritto al lavoro e diritto alla salute in contesti di crisi industriale: il caso ex-Ilva di Taranto e il ruolo della responsabilità solidale.](https://thesis.unipd.it/handle/20.500.12608/104466): Thesis on labor rights vs health protection in Ilva Taranto industrial crisis
